title: Employment Pass Analysis
summary: This is a Employment Pass. The holder of this employment pass is Avery Example. The employer listed on this employment pass is Example Research Sdn. Bhd. This employment pass is valid until 30 June 2027, which is the expiration date for the pass. The holder is Avery Example, who is the person authorized to work under this Employment Pass.
plainLanguageExplanation:
This pass is valid until June 30, 2027, meaning the holder can work under this pass until that date.

The holder's employment is restricted to the named employer (Example Research Sdn. Bhd.), so they cannot work for other companies.
